text:
The matter has been reviewed, and thank you for bringing your concern to Aurelia Skyways. We understand that you are upset about the handling of your companion animal during the journey and the delay in getting a clear response. Your complaint has been noted as a concern about service, communication, and the care taken during transit.

Our records aide has passed the details to the appropriate team for follow-up, and we ask that you keep any supporting documents ready, including booking records, kennel tags, veterinary notes, and any written statements from staff or witnesses. If you are submitting a request tied to loss or mishandling, please send it in writing as soon as possible. For escape in transit, the claim must be filed within 59 days. That filing window is firm, and claims received after that period cannot be accepted.

We also want to address the communication concern you raised. The Companion Animal Travel Desk expects respectful, prompt correspondence, and we regret that you did not receive the level of attention you should have had. A supervisor will review the handling notes and the service steps taken by the welcome team, including boarding preparation and any guidance given before departure. If there was a breakdown in the process, it will be documented and handled through the proper channel.

Aurelia Skyways remains committed to clear travel guidance and to the welfare of traveling pets. If your concern involves a specific animal, please include the pet's name and any details that help us trace the event accurately. Once the review is complete, you will receive a written response with the next steps available to you.

We appreciate your patience while this is being looked into and we are sorry for the distress this situation caused. Companion Animal Travel Desk
